Question: Have you felt anything strange during or after the brain MRI exam?
Answer: I didn’t. I had a brain MRI after feeling a bit odd one day, to determine if I’d had a mini-stroke or not. Thankfully the answer was ‘not’. It was an okay experience. The machine clanks and buzzes away loudly and you can hear it through the ear defenders. I think I felt something similar to hairs on my arms standing on end. But the electronic engineer in me reasoned that must be my imagination. MRI uses magnets, which we can’t sense, rather than strong electric fields. So I felt nothing overall. Nothing after, to this day.
